tests.name: Create Systemd Service and Timer
tests.description: This test creates Systemd service and timer then starts and enables the Systemd timer

tests.name: Create a user level transient systemd service and timer
tests.description: Schedule a user level transient task (will not survive a reboot) without having to create the .timer or .service files by using the systemd-run command.

tests.name: Create a system level transient systemd service and timer
tests.description: Schedule a system level transient task (will not survive a reboot) without having to create the .timer or .service files by using the systemd-run command.
